security.loopback_only: docker inspect HostIp=127.0.0.1 for 13000/18000/25432; netstat LISTEN only 127.0.0.1; LAN 10.121.216.146 and 172.21.96.1 -> connection refused on all three ports
security.admin_interfaces: Prefect and MLflow are not part of staging Compose (static regression test); F7 MLflow UI was previously verified loopback-only; PostgreSQL loopback only
security.least_privilege: API uses bikeflow_reader: SELECT OK; INSERT/UPDATE/DROP/CREATE -> InsufficientPrivilege; wrong password rejected. Containers: cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, non-root (10001/node/postgres), read-only rootfs api/web, mem/cpu/pids limits
security.http_perimeter_live: POST body 413, chunked 413, query >8 KiB 431, header >16 KiB 431 (test), foreign CORS origin -> no ACAO header, SQL-injection station_id -> empty result, data intact; nosniff/DENY/no-referrer/no-store + release header; web CSP/frame-ancestors/permissions-policy present
security.rate_limit: per-client fixed 60 s window (600/min default, 6000/min staging) -> 429 + Retry-After VERIFIED by integration test (limit 3); live 6100 sequential requests took 105.75 s (< 100 rps), so the 6000/min staging budget was never exceeded: live 429 NOT VERIFIED
security.secrets: passwords generated by init into ignored data/staging/runtime.env (exclusive create, never rotated implicitly); docker logs db/api/web: 0 password and 0 DSN occurrences; access log disabled, structured status/latency only
security.tls: BLOCKED: no domain, certificate or public endpoint approved; loopback HTTP only
security.residual: CSP keeps 'unsafe-inline' for Next.js inline bootstrap (no nonce); /docs and /openapi.json exposed read-only

web_zlib_CVE-2023-45853.scope: CVE names MiniZip zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64. dpkg -L zlib1g exposes only libz; find / -iname *minizip* finds no MiniZip component. App serves JSON/HTML; no ZIP upload/extraction endpoint. Vulnerable code reachability not proven; package finding retained, not claimed exploitable/cleared.

db_libxml2_CVE-2026-6653.scope: Crafted XML/use-after-free in DB libxml2. API uses parameterized fixed SELECTs, no XML processing or raw SQL endpoint; DB is loopback and API role SELECT-only. Direct SQL XML processing by an authenticated DB user remains a potential surface. No exploit validation or owner acceptance claimed.
